research_question: Can a fixed 15:20 broad-PIT price/volume snapshot identify close-to-next-session continuation without a regime label?
legacy_distinction: Legacy TREND_FOLLOW scanned at 14:00 and evaluated every bar through 15:55. This is a new fixed-clock family, not a legacy replay.
technical_corrections_before_performance: The first feature-build invocation timed out after 1000 seconds while using thread workers for pandas-heavy per-day feature extraction. It wrote no parquet, manifest, selection, return, or PnL artifact.

A process-worker retry was manually terminated before its first 50-ticker checkpoint because the same per-day slicing remained too slow. It also wrote no parquet, manifest, selection, return, or PnL artifact. The builder was vectorized by ticker before the first performance run; the panel, features, rules, dates, and gates were unchanged.

The first replay invocation stopped in trade construction before simulation, selection output, return output, or PnL because selected BIIB was halted for the scheduled next session. The missing-price contract was completed before performance: an already-selected halted name exits at its first later regular-session bar within five calendar days, with no drop or refill and borrow charged through actual exit.

The second replay invocation stopped before simulation, selection output, return output, or PnL because selected GRUB had no later bar after its final pre-delisting session. Before performance, the generic unreplayable policy was completed: if no bar exists within five calendar days, the selected leg receives a conservative 100% notional loss regardless of direction, no exit proceeds, no drop, and no refill. This is a lower bound, not a reconstructed merger consideration.

data_contract.universe: quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with daily PIT eligibility and ADV20 >= 10m; price >= 5
data_contract.signal_clock: only five-minute bars with timestamp strictly before 15:20 ET; the last signal bar is 15:15 and closes at 15:20
data_contract.entry: exact 15:20 five-minute open after the 15:15 bar closes
data_contract.missing_exit: post-selection first regular-session five-minute open at or after the scheduled timestamp, capped at five calendar days; if none exists, assign a conservative 100% leg-notional loss regardless of direction with no exit proceeds; the selected name is never dropped or refilled; missing entry is filtered before ranking and full refill

feature_definitions.intraday_return: 15:15 close divided by 09:30 open minus one
feature_definitions.late_return: 15:15 close divided by 14:20 open minus one
feature_definitions.volume_ratio: cumulative 09:30-15:15 bar-dollar-volume divided by ADV20 times 70/78
feature_definitions.persistent_direction: intraday_return and late_return have the same sign and abs(late_return) >= 0.003
feature_definitions.fixed_pullback_resume: 15:10 close within 0.5% of EMA20 through 15:10; 15:10 volume below prior-10 average; 15:15 volume above 1.3 times prior-10 average; direction agrees with intraday trend

variants.name: cs_momo_ls_overnight
variants.rule: top/bottom intraday return, long positive and short negative

variants.name: cs_momo_ls_next1520
variants.rule: top/bottom intraday return, long positive and short negative

variants.name: volume_confirmed_ls_next1520
variants.rank: absolute intraday return times capped volume ratio

variants.name: persistent_late_ls_next1520
variants.rank: absolute intraday return times absolute late return

variants.name: pullback_resume_long_next1520
variants.rule: positive intraday trend plus fixed_pullback_resume LONG

portfolio.long_short: up to three names per side with matched long/short counts, 10% current NAV absolute weight each, maximum 0.6x gross
portfolio.long_only: up to three longs, 20% current NAV each, maximum 0.6x gross
portfolio.sic_cap: maximum one ticker per SIC per side
portfolio.selection: rank after exact-entry filtering; rebuild and fully refill every session

development_gate.winner: highest base-cost Sharpe then CAGR among passers

multiple_testing_policy: Exactly five frozen rows. No post-result clock, threshold, horizon, direction, rank, or position-count changes.
production_policy: A validation pass permits further audit only, not production PASS.
